scenarios.setup: Use a token whose exp is before the service clock.
scenarios.expected: 401 invalid_token and no TypeSafe upstream call.

scenarios.setup: Revoke the OAuth grant or remove the signing key at the authorized issuer.
scenarios.expected: The next MCP request is denied; cached credentials are not treated as proof of access.

scenarios.setup: Complete issuer re-authentication after revocation and obtain a fresh token.
scenarios.expected: The fresh token can discover and call the tool; the client does not reuse the revoked token.
